examples.arabic: أبو كرم أكد كلامها: "صحيح، ما في قدامنا غير نتعاون ونكون إيجابيين حتى لو الوضع صعب جداً."
examples.english: Abu Karam confirmed her words: "That's right, we have no choice but to cooperate and be positive, even if the situation is very difficult."
examples.transliteration: Abu Karam akkad kalamha: "Sa7iḥ, ma fi qiddamna ghair neta3aawan w nkuun iijabiyyiin 7atta law el wada3 sa3eb jiddan."

examples.arabic: ماما قالت الثلاجة ما عم تشتغل منيح وهالوضع صار صعب
examples.english: Mom said the fridge isn't working well and this situation became difficult.
examples.transliteration: Mama qalat el tallajeh ma am tishtaghel mneeh w hal wada' sar sa'ab.

examples.arabic: فكرت انها رح تكون سهل بس كانت شوي صعب
examples.english: I thought it would be easy but it was a bit difficult.
examples.transliteration: Fakkart enna-ha raḥ tkun sahel bas kanat shway sa'eb.

examples.english: God willing, it will help us with the difficult history project.
examples.storyTitle: An Old Map in Souq al-Hamidiyyeh

examples.arabic: عمر جاوبها اهلين يا ليلى انا قلقان شوي عشان بنتي عندها امتحان صعب بكرة
examples.english: Omar replied to her Hello Layla I'm a little worried because my daughter has a difficult exam tomorrow
examples.transliteration: Omar jaawabha ahleen ya Layla ana qalqaan shway ashaan binti 'andha imtiḥaan ṣa'b bukra
